links.outcome: Output reproducibility of LLM-based cognitive classification across repeated runs
links.effect: Complete output stability across five independent runs; 83.3% agreement with manual scoring, kappa 0.74.
links.quote: demonstrated complete output stability across five independent runs

unlisted_practices: Digitized culturally adapted Arabic MoCA with multimodal AI scoring compared against manual clinical scoring
Excluding technically compromised audio recordings from analysis (accuracy rose from 83.3% to 90.9%)

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility and accuracy of a multimodal AI system integrating speech, vision, and LLM reasoning to automate Arabic MoCA cognitive screening using data from 24 participants.
